Out of 20 grooves, the from-scratch model got through ${r.S.ok}, the model with pre-training only ${r.P.ok}, and the pre-trained and post-trained one ${r.PF.ok}. In the single recording, the groove first turns one way. On grooves with the same first turn, the from-scratch model got through ${r.sameOk} of ${r.sameN}, and on those with the opposite turn ${r.otherOk} of ${r.otherN}: a mirrored groove is unfamiliar to it. The pre-trained model saw turns both ways in other tasks, but nobody taught it to insert the peg slowly, and without post-training it rams the socket on ${r.P.bump} of the 20 grooves. Post-training on one recording taught it that, although afterwards it hits the walls on some grooves: one recording is too little even for post-training. It's the same in π0: pre-training provides general skills and corrections, and post-training, how to do a specific task.

In the FAST paper, one second of T-shirt folding at 50 Hz took 53 tokens instead of 700.
Перед округлением FAST умножает коэффици: Before rounding, FAST multiplies the coefficients by a scale γ, 10 by default. The smaller γ is, the coarser the rounding and the more coefficients turn into zeros. Set γ = 3 and find the k with the smallest error.
При этом k ошибка наименьшая для γ = 3: This k gives the smallest error for γ = 3

При γ = 3 ошибка не опускается ниже ${fm: At γ = 3, the error doesn't drop below ${fmt(a.err, 2)} px, while at γ = 10 it goes down to ${fmt(b.err, 2)}: each coefficient is rounded with an error of up to 1/(2γ), and these errors add up over the 50 ticks of the path. On the other hand, there are fewer nonzero numbers. γ sets how much precision you give up for compression; the FAST authors chose 10 and write that the result isn't very sensitive to it.

π0 выдаёт действия токенами, как OpenVLA: Does π0 output actions as tokens, like OpenVLA?
Нет: языковая модель остаётся, а непреры: No: the language model stays, and a chunk of continuous actions is built by the action expert with flow matching
Нет: действия выдаёт отдельная модель, к: No: the actions come from a separate model that doesn't see the images
Токены картинок и текста проходят через: The image and text tokens go through PaliGemma, the action tokens through the action expert, which turns noise into a chunk of 50 continuous actions in 10 Euler steps. It's π0-FAST that outputs actions as tokens.
Откуда эксперт действий знает, что на ка: How does the action expert know what's in the images and in the command?
У него свои камеры и свой энкодер картин: It has its own cameras and its own image encoder
Веса у него свои, но трансформер общий:: Its weights are its own, but the transformer is shared: the action tokens read the image and text tokens through attention
PaliGemma пересказывает ему сцену тексто: PaliGemma describes the scene to it in text
Эксперт — вторая, меньшая группа весов т: The expert is a second, smaller set of weights in the same transformer, about 300M parameters. The state and action tokens pass through its weights, and it meets PaliGemma only in attention. The images and text are computed once and sit in the cache.
Команды 50 раз в секунду — значит, π0 вы: Commands 50 times per second: does that mean π0 is called 50 times per second?
Нет: один инференс даёт пачку из 50 дейс: No: one inference call gives a chunk of 50 actions; the robot executes 25 and gets a new chunk every 0.5 s
Нет: модель вызывают раз в секунду: No: the model is called once per second
Инференс занимает 73 мс на RTX 4090, а и: Inference takes 73 ms on an RTX 4090, and executing 25 actions takes 0.5 s. The chunk defines the motion between inference calls.
Десять шагов flow matching — это десять: Are ten flow matching steps ten passes of the whole 3.3B-parameter model?
Да, поэтому инференс медленный: Yes, that's why inference is slow
Нет: картинки и текст проходят через VLM: No: the images and text pass through the VLM once and sit in the cache, and only the expert passes over the 50 action tokens 10 times
Из 73 мс на картинки и текст уходит 46 м: Of the 73 ms, the images and text take 46 ms, and all 10 flow steps take 27 ms. The block mask makes it possible not to recompute the observation.
Если записать много аккуратных демонстра: If you record many clean demonstrations of a task, is pre-training unnecessary?
Да, аккуратные данные лучше любых: Yes, clean data beats any other data
Нет: в аккуратных записях нет ошибок и и: No: clean recordings have no mistakes or corrections, and a model trained only on them is brittle
Нет, предобучение нужно только для языка: No, pre-training is needed only for language
Авторы π0 пишут, что модель, обученная т: The π0 authors write that training only on high-quality data “results in a brittle model that does not reliably recover from mistakes.” Diverse data provides corrections, post-training provides quality; the gain from pre-training reached a factor of two.
FAST повышает точность токенов, добавляя: Does FAST make tokens more precise by adding bins?
Да, вместо 256 корзин берёт 1024: Yes, it uses 1024 bins instead of 256
Нет: он сжимает пачку косинусным преобра: No: it compresses the chunk with the cosine transform, rounding and BPE, and the number of tokens drops several-fold
Нет: он убирает токены и выдаёт числа: No: it does away with tokens and outputs numbers
Секунда складывания футболки на 50 Гц —: One second of T-shirt folding at 50 Hz is 53 FAST tokens instead of 700 with bins, roughly 30 tokens per arm per second.
π0-FAST лучше π0 во всём?: Is π0-FAST better than π0 in every way?
Да: она и учится, и работает быстрее: Yes: it both trains and runs faster
Нет: учится она в 5 раз быстрее, но на п: No: it trains 5 times faster, but spends about 750 ms per chunk, while π0 fits into 100 ms
Нет: она хуже на всех задачах: No: it's worse on every task
Токены по одному декодирует вся языковая: The tokens are decoded one at a time by the whole language model inside PaliGemma, the 2B-parameter Gemma, while in π0 the 10 flow steps are done by the 300M expert. On static tasks this didn't get in the way; for fast ones, the authors call it a limitation.
Время τ для обучения π0 берут равномерно: Is the time τ for training π0 sampled uniformly from 0 to 1?
Да, как в первых работах о flow matching: Yes, as in the original flow matching papers
Нет: из бета-распределения, которое чаще: No: from a beta distribution that favors noisy moments, because the mean action is hard to predict from the observation
Авторы рассуждают так: наблюдение робота: The authors reason that a robot's observation almost uniquely determines the action, so even the start of the path from noise demands a lot of work from the network. Moments above s = 0.999 aren't sampled at all.
